rationale: ADMA gapped up ~14.6% on an earnings beat but is now trading below its 9-EMA ($13.48) with the last five candles showing a clear step-down from $13.44 to $13.21, suggesting the morning momentum has faded and sellers are in control. The broader market is under severe stress (SPY -4.19%, VIXY +27.08%), which creates unfavorable conditions for holding a gap-up long, while the stock's position at 70.6% of its range with declining volume on recent candles makes a short entry risky given residual gap-up support near VWAP ($13.13). With no clean directional edge and a hostile macro backdrop, the risk/reward is insufficient to commit capital.
